messages:
Michaela: Quick Q — can we surface routing/quota hints in the saved-queries list preview? users keep asking which model/route will be used and roughly how costly a query is.
Sujeet: +1, support has multiple tickets. Do we actually have the telemetry to make a decent estimate at preview time?
Ben: We have per-route avg token and p90 histograms from telemetry, and model profiles for unit-cost. Main challenge is shaping an API that stays backward compatible.
Priya: From infra side I think adding an optional hint blob to the saved_query object is safest. Callers can ignore it.
Michaela: UX wants a compact badge: cost(low/med/high), model pill, and a routing tier (hosted/dedicated). Also emphasize "estimate" not guaranteed.
Sujeet: I recommend computing the estimate offline (batch job) and storing it with the saved query meta — no realtime routing. Also include the percentile we used.
Ben: Proposed optional field: `runtime_hint`. Example snippet we could return:
```json
"runtime_hint": {"expected_tokens": 420, "expected_p90": 820, "model_hint": "redwood-001", "routing_policy": "dedicated-preferred", "quota_tier": "medium"}
```
Michaela: That looks good. In the console list the preview would show: [redwood-001] [Medium cost] [Dedicated] and an info hover that explains how it's calculated.
Priya: Telemetry note — we'll use last 30 days sampling and p90 on request length *and* a small multiplier for model-specific generation overhead. Need to record algorithm in docs.
Sujeet: API shape OK but two asks: 1) fields should be stable names, 2) make sure it's optional to avoid breaking older clients. For migration show "estimate unavailable" when absent.
Ben: Agreed. Also add `estimated_confidence` (low/medium/high) so UX can decide whether to surface anything at all.
Michaela: Rollout plan: canary to 5% accounts with a short survey CTA in the preview to validate usefulness. If confidence low, hide cost badge.
ConsoleBot: deploy: saved-query-api:v3 rolled to staging at 2024-11-12T18:04:22Z :rocket:
Priya: For computation pipeline I'll add a job that merges per-route token histogram with model-cost table and emits the hint document nightly. We'll version the hint schema (v1).
Sujeet: Perf check: avoid per-saved-query joins at render time. Console should fetch saved queries and the precomputed hints in the same response or in a single bulk call.
Ben: I'll open a PR for the API that introduces `runtime_hint` (optional) plus `hint_schema_version` and `estimated_confidence`. Will keep it behind a feature flag.
Michaela: Thanks — I'll mock the UI screens for the canary and add copy for the hover tooltip.
Sujeet: Ping me when PR is up, I'll review load implications.
Michaela: Awesome, thanks team! :tada:
